authority: User explicitly requested the pending Arkiv agent-to-agent protocol while the teammate builds the existing frontend
scope: Working hackathon agent task, claim, exclusive assignment, authenticated A2A reproduction/review, signed evidence and actual Arkiv publication/read-back
signing: RFC8785 canonical JSON with detached Ed25519 signatures and per-agent binding versions; no signature field inside hashed payload
authorization: Pinned operator-approved service keys/endpoints/wallets, current project membership and revocation; no ENS or institutional verification claim
deployment: Separately keyed team-controlled local provider processes with private durable SQLite task stores and real public MUR captures; no Supabase credential distributed to providers
public_policy: Explicit consent for minimal public task/result metadata; private questions, raw captures and credentials remain off-chain
recovery: Atomic PostgreSQL intents, fenced leases, provider message deduplication and durable pre-send chain reservations; ambiguous sends require reconciliation rather than blind resend
deferred: Full production federation and long-term archive
phase_gate: Real task -> signed claim -> one assignment -> official A2A exchange -> recomputed signed result -> separately keyed review; live Arkiv owner/digest read-back and focused security/recovery/regression checks
